description: Source code for RestApi class implementing REST API endpoints for TestLink project, including project, test plan, build, test case, and execution management, with authentication and permission checks.

classes.name: RestApi
classes.description: Main class providing REST API endpoints for TestLink, handling authentication, project management, test case creation, execution, and related operations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles API key authentication from request headers.

methods.name: setContentTypeJSON
methods.description: Sets response content type to application/json.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns info about the current API user.

methods.name: testprojects
methods.description: Retrieves list of test projects accessible to the user.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Internal method to fetch test project data based on parameters.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Fetches latest version info of test cases for a project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves test plans for a project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Fetches builds associated with a test plan.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build within a test plan.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates an existing build.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Creates a test case execution record, with environment checks.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Links platforms to a test plan after validation.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case with validation and relatives check.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a new keyword linked to a test project.

methods.name: buildPropMapping
methods.description: Returns mapping of build property names.

methods.name: buildTestCaseObj
methods.description: Constructs a test case object from input, validating relatives.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Validates environment for executing a test case, including permissions, build, platform, and test case existence.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Checks if test project and suite IDs are valid and related.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Checks if current user has specified rights on project/test plan.

methods.name: getStdOp
methods.description: Returns standard success response structure.

methods.name: getStdIDKO
methods.description: Returns standard error response structure with ID.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Returns HTTP 500 response with error message.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Formats exception message with line number.
